name: Akari Teishoku
source:
Akari is called to the gym equipment room by Mr. Miracle. She is in for interactive touching adventure there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
